title: Trending tickers: Meta, Google, AMD, Next and Currys
summary: A landmark social media case, AI chips and CEO reshuffles moved markets on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 周三，具有里程碑意义的社交媒体案例、人工智能芯片和首席执行官改组影响了市场。

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks slip amid doubts over US-Iran peace deal
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：因美伊和平协议存疑，股市下跌
summary: White House insists peace talks with Iran are ongoing, while Tehran has publicly rejected US overtures
summary_zh: 白宫坚称与伊朗的和平谈判正在进行中，而德黑兰则公开拒绝了美国的提议

title: Google top India counsel quits in latest departure amid regulatory hurdles, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，谷歌印度首席法律顾问因监管障碍而辞职
summary: Google's top India counsel, Bijoya Roy, has resigned after ‌16 months in the role, two sources ‌said, a high-profile exit in a key market where the U.S. ​tech giant is facing regulatory hurdles and also lacks a government relations head.
summary_zh: 两名消息人士称，谷歌印度首席法律顾问 Bijoya Roy 在担任该职位 16 个月后辞职，这是谷歌在印度面临监管障碍且缺乏政府关系主管的关键市场的高调退出。

title: Google Memory Breakthrough Prompts Global Chipmaker Selloff
title_zh: 谷歌内存突破促使全球芯片制造商抛售
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Shares of computer memory and storage makers slumped after Google researchers touted a new compression technique that could reduce the amount of memory needed for artificial intelligence workloads.SK Hynix Inc., a key maker of memory chips for artificial intelli...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——在谷歌研究人员推出一种新的压缩技术后，计算机内存和存储制造商的股价暴跌，该技术可以减少人工智能工作负载所需的内存量。SK 海力士公司是人工智能内存芯片的主要制造商。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide as Wall Street weighs prospects for Iran truce
title_zh: 今日股市：华尔街权衡伊朗休战前景，道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: The war in Iran is leading the markets on a roller coaster of moves as Trump and Tehran issue conflicting statements around negotiations.
summary_zh: 随着特朗普和德黑兰围绕谈判发表相互矛盾的声明，伊朗战争正引领市场出现过山车般的波动。

title: Wall Street advances as investors bet on Mideast de-escalation
title_zh: 投资者押注中东局势缓和，华尔街上涨

title: Meta, Google found liable in social media addiction case
title_zh: Meta、谷歌在社交媒体成瘾案中被判负有责任
summary: Yahoo Finance's Dan Howley chats with anchor Josh Lipton about the landmark court ruling that found Meta (META) and Google (GOOG, GOOGL) liable for $6 million in damages over charges of addictive platform design, setting a key precedent as thousands of similar cases loom.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与主播乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 讨论了具有里程碑意义的法院裁决，该裁决裁定 Meta (META) 和谷歌 (GOOG, GOOGL) 因令人上瘾的平台设计指控承担 600 万美元的赔偿责任，在数千起类似案件即将...

title: Could SpaceX file for IPO as soon as this week?
title_zh: SpaceX 最早可以在本周申请 IPO 吗？
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma speaks with Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian about Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) and the recent speculation around whether it could file for an IPO as soon as this week.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 与雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 谈论了埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 以及最近关于该公司是否可能最早在本周申请 IPO 的猜测。

title: Meta, YouTube found negligent in landmark social media addiction lawsuit
title_zh: Meta、YouTube 在具有里程碑意义的社交媒体成瘾诉讼中被裁定疏忽
summary: The jury in a landmark lawsuit against social media companies ruled in favor of plaintiffs on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 周三，陪审团在针对社交媒体公司的一项具有里程碑意义的诉讼中做出了有利于原告的裁决。
